info.title: API.SH: Naukri
info.description: The Naukri API from API.SH: public Naukri data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One company's profile on Naukri: name, logo, banner, overall rating and review count, followers, motto, tags (industry, ownership), about text, type, founding year, size, headquarters, website, rating by category (culture, job security, work life, salary, career growth), employee-reported benefits, company-listed benefits, salaries by role (in lakhs per year), reviews by job role, interview questions by role, offices with address and coordinates, social links, leaders, awards, photos, videos, the company's own story blocks and similar companies, plus `raw`. Unknown companies answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/naukri-company

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The company's id (the number at the end of its overview URL, e.g. `10476` in `accenture-overview-10476`; `similar_companies[].id`) or the overview URL.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Open jobs of one company on Naukri (its careers page on the site), with the same filters, facets and job fields as `/naukri/v1/search`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Named filters (`industry`, `department`, `role`, `education`, `company_type`, `company`, `city` ...) take the ids shown in `facets` and work like `filter`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/naukri-company-jobs

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: The company's jobs page slug, e.g. `capgemini-jobs-careers-649` (`company_jobs_slug` in search results), or its URL.

parameters.name: experience
parameters.description: Years of experience the job must accept (0-30).

parameters.name: salary
parameters.description: Salary bands (lakhs per year), comma-separated: `0to3`, `3to6`, `6to10`, `10to15`, `15to25`, `25to50`, `50to75`, `75to100`, `100to500`.

parameters.name: freshness
parameters.description: Posted within this many days.

parameters.name: work_mode
parameters.description: Comma-separated: `office`, `remote`, `hybrid`, `temp_wfh`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: More filters as `key:value` from `facets[].values[].filter`, e.g. `qctopGroupId:10476` (a company) or `industryTypeIdGid:109`. Repeatable.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (20 jobs per page). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

get.description:
Employee reviews of a company from AmbitionBox (Naukri's company review site), 20 a page: overall and category ratings, likes and dislikes, job profile, department, location, employment type, work policy, work days, timing and travel, verified flag, dates and link; plus the company's rating, category ratings, star distribution, work policy split, top mentions, top job profiles, departments with ratings, and location and designation filters. Filter by designation, location or department; sort popular or latest. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/naukri-company-reviews

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: The company's AmbitionBox name (accenture, tcs, infosys) or its ambitionbox.com link (reviews_url from /naukri/v1/company).

parameters.name: designation
parameters.description: Job profile url name, e.g. team-lead (see filters.designations).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City url name, e.g. bengaluru (see filters.locations).

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Department url name, e.g. engineering-software-qa (see departments).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: popular (default) or latest.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Jobs on Naukri.com (India) for a keyword and/or location, with the site's filters: experience, salary band, freshness, work mode, sort, and every facet the results page offers. `total` is Naukri's count. Facets come back in `facets` (work mode, location, salary, company, industry, department, role, education, company type, posted by…) with counts; pass a value's `filter` (e.g. `cityTypeGid:97`) back as `filter` (repeatable, or several joined with `;`). Each job: `id`, `title`, `company`, `company_id`, `group_id`, `company_jobs_slug` (for `/naukri/v1/company/jobs`), `logo`, `url`, `experience` (min, max, label), `salary` (label, min, max in INR per year, hidden), `location`, `locations`, `work_mode`, `skills`, `snippet`, `posted_at`, `posted_label`, `openings`, `walk_in`, `company_rating` and `company_reviews` (AmbitionBox), `promoted` and `raw` (the site's record). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Named filters (`industry`, `department`, `role`, `education`, `company_type`, `company`, `city` ...) take the ids shown in `facets` and work like `filter`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/naukri-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
